aiResearchSummary.text: Entocycle is researching and developing a control system and methods for insect breeding apparatus, as described in the title 'Control system and methods for insect breeding apparatus.' The abstract details a system for controlling a fly breeding apparatus, which includes enclosures for flies and input devices such as machine vision for monitoring and managing the breeding process. These efforts focus on optimizing the containment and control of insect populations for scalable insect farming.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $2,600,000, or 13.96% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $1,520,000, representing 8.16% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,859,512 to $41,253,395, a 10.69x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
